_comment: One-time-derived reference for the biotech earnings sweep universe, built by build_universe.py from EDGAR (authoritative). CIK, fiscal_year_end, filer_type, half_yearly and the results history do not change quarter to quarter - do NOT re-derive them per run. Biotechs have no supplemental: the press release furnished as EX-99 on the results 8-K (results_source edgar_8k_ex99) or 6-K (edgar_6k) is the primary document, backed by the 10-Q/10-K or the 6-K quarterly/half-year report.
_how_results_are_detected: By reading the heading of the EX-99 exhibit(s) on each candidate filing, NOT by Item code alone: biotechs furnish Item 2.02 8-Ks in January for preliminary cash / JPM releases (SNDX, KURA, KYMR, SMMT, CATX), which are not results and are listed per company under other_item_202_8ks. Foreign private issuers (BNTX, NBTX, TLX) file 6-K with no Item codes; their results 6-K is told apart from routine 6-Ks by the same heading test, and their quarterly/half-year report 6-K by reportDate == period end != filing date (BNTX form6-kq22026quarterlyrepo.htm, NBTX nbx-20260630.htm, TLX tlx-20260630.htm). See edgar_common.RESULTS_RE for the calibrated pattern.
_quarter_labels: Labels follow each company's fiscal calendar: ENGN (FYE 31 Oct) 3Q26 = quarter ended 2026-07-31, NRIX (FYE 30 Nov) 3Q26 = 2026-08-31; everyone else fiscal == calendar. Half-yearly reporters (NBTX, TLX) use 1Hyy (June period) and FYyy (December period); a 2Qyy target maps to 1Hyy and 4Qyy to FYyy, and 1Q/3Q targets have nothing to wait for. TLX's quarterly revenue 'trading update' 6-Ks are listed under other_periodic_6ks as interim_update and are not results.
_scheduling_note: Use reporting_lag_days per ticker: start watching at (period end + min lag - 2 days) and stop once the results filing is seen. Half-yearly names report ~50-90 days after 30 June / 31 December, far later than the US quarterly names (~35-45 days).
